A policy target, observed maximum, technical MW potential or scenario is not an identified ceiling. K=1 is only physical bound, not sourced regional prior.

Do not fit a new K unless independently identified evidence qualifies and an additional pre-fit specification is frozen; otherwise report candidate-specific blocks.
